summary: Windows 10, 1.0.62, COM9: model TH-D7 selected; kenwood_d7 ID check got TH-D7G and raised 'Radio reports TH-D7G (not TH-D7)'. CHIRP has a separate Kenwood_TH-D7G driver; the user needs that model, but the error did not say so.
title: TH-D7G read as TH-D7 stops at 'Radio reports TH-D7G' with no next step
